mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assignment_submissions (assignment_id, enrollment_id, user_id, submission_file, submission_text, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{assignmentId}, #{enrollmentId}, #{userId}, #{submissionFile}, #{submissionText}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM assignment_submissions WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM assignment_submissions WHERE enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM assignment_submissions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM assignment_submissions WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM assignment_submissions WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE assignment_submissions SET submission_file = #{submissionFile}, submission_text = #{submissionText}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE assignment_submissions SET status = #{status}, submitted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE assignment_submissions SET score = #{score}, feedback = #{feedback}, status = 'GRADED', graded_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment_submissions WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment_submissions WHERE enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId}
